package.name: nuxeo-agentic-documents
package.title: Nuxeo Satori document control: numbering, supersession, transmittals, review cycles and export-control marks

description.p: The document control module's server add-on. A document whose type carries the ControlledDocument facet is numbered from the platform's sequencer, in a number series a package registers: unique in its series, and never reused. A new revision names the one it supersedes: it is given that revision's number and the next revision, and the old one is marked superseded and linked both ways in the same transaction, refused when the user may not write the old one.

A transmittal lists current revisions, by number or id, and is sent to named users for review, for construction or for information, by a due day: each recipient gets a receipt, which they alone acknowledge, or return with a comment, once, and the server records when. A review cycle reviews one revision in Nuxeo's own comments: each thread stays open until the cycle's opener resolves it, the cycle closes only with none open, and a closed cycle is recorded on the revision.

A revision may carry an export-control mark: a classification and the groups that may receive it. The platform's download endpoints refuse the revision's files and renditions, and the server a transmittal of it, to anyone in none of those groups, an administrator included. The mark carries over to the revision that supersedes it; setting, changing or removing one needs the add-on's ChangeExportMark permission, and each change is written to the platform's audit.
It does nothing until a package registers a series and gives its types the add-on's facets. It adds no Automation operation.
